title: Antibiotic Stocks Preparation
author: Alba Balletbó
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7krhkv6

steps.title: Weigh antibiotic powders
steps.instruction: Weigh the antibiotic powders needed to prepare 10 mL of the recommended stock concentration solution.

steps.title: Dissolve powders in solvent
steps.instruction: Add the weighed powder to molecular‑grade water (dH₂O) for all antibiotics except chloramphenicol, which should be added to ethanol; vortex vigorously until the powder is completely dissolved.

substeps.instruction: Add weighed powder to the appropriate solvent (MQ or ethanol).
Vortex vigorously until the powder is fully dissolved.

steps.title: Filter‑sterilize and aliquot
steps.instruction: Filter‑sterilize the resulting stock solution and dispense into 1.5 mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Store stock aliquots
steps.instruction: Store the 1000X stock aliquots at –20 °C until needed, as recommended by Addgene.

steps.title: Dilute stock into LB
steps.instruction: When preparing growth media, dilute the 1000X stock 1:1000 into LB medium; for example, add 100 µL of a 100 mg/mL ampicillin stock (1000X) to 100 mL of LB.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the 1000X stock 1:1000 into LB medium.
Example: add 100 µL of 100 mg/mL ampicillin stock to 100 mL LB.
